notes.title: 2023.4 Update
notes.notes:
[b]FIX[/b] Precision issue during lasso selection tracing.

[b]FIX[/b] Fixed crash when drawing outside the maximum size limits for a canvas.

[b]FIX[/b] Some popups were not rendered correctly when using multiple child windows.

[b]Update[/b] When clicking on a selection in exclusive mode (with the Magic Wand & Color Select, you can drag the selection around without the need to press the T shortcut. 

[url=https://blackink.bleank.com/Blog/update2023-4/]more..[/url]

notes.title: Update 2023.3
notes.notes:
[b][Update][/b] Popups contained within windows that move behind child windows will still be displayed within the content of the child windows. [url=https://blackink.bleank.com/Blog/20233/][more..][/url]

[b][Fixed][/b] Some Random Crash

[b][Fixed][/b] Crash when you do a Undo / Redo when the Eyedropper tool is activated

notes.title: Black Ink 2020.3 Hotfix
notes.notes:
[h1]The [b]Black Ink 2020.3 Hotfix[/b] is out[/h1]


[i]List of fixes :[/i]

[list]
[*] Black Ink doesn’t start with CPU that have more than 32 CORE detected
[*] Crash at startup if the GPU provides several device
[*] Crash when using the command/shortcut “Fill eyedropper”
[*] When using the command “Duplicate as layer”, the content of this layer was still influenced by modifications made by its original operators.
[*] Random crash after using the CropTool
[*] Rendering problem with brushes: Canvas Fill, Free Fill and Polygonal Fill
[*] Brush with dual primitive (like Charcoal) can miss the secondary texture when rendered
[*] Crash when pasting in a Grayscale layer
[*] When a RGBA image is dragged and dropped into a grayscale layer the layer is transformed into a RGBA layer.
[/list]
